# npm script and hard-gate wiring for the node-surface check

**Goal:** `npm run check:ui-node-surface` exists and is a **hard gate** on the
implementation / dev-push path (Q2 → A): a reintroduced Phaser value import in a
listed module must fail the gate before it reaches downstream game suites.
Parent: CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `package.json` gains `"check:ui-node-surface"` running the check script
      (precedent: `npx tsx scripts/...`, deterministic, seconds, no network, no
      Vitest run).
- [ ] The check is a hard gate: wired so the build step `implement.py finish`
      runs (and the dev-push path) executes it first — recommended mechanism: a
      `"prebuild": "npm run check:ui-node-surface"` chained script, so every
      `npm run build` (the gate `implement.py finish` and PR CI run) starts with
      the static check. Gate lands exactly on `build`; `build:*`-style scripts
      are unaffected (npm pre/post hooks are script-name-scoped).
- [ ] Runs green on a clean tree; a deliberately introduced Phaser value import
      in a listed module makes the gate fail — the before/after command output
      is recorded in a comment on CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN (parent AC 5).
- [ ] The check's own unit coverage (`tests/scripts/check-ui-node-surface.test.ts`)
      is part of the unit profile gate.
- [ ] `npm run build` (TypeScript strict + Vite) succeeds.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.


- [ ] `npm run check:ui-node-surface` is wired into the implementation gate
      (per Q2) and runs green on a clean tree; a deliberately introduced Phaser
      value import in a listed module makes it fail (documented in the item
      comment with the command output).

## Minimal implementation

- Add the `check:ui-node-surface` script to `package.json`.
- Add the `prebuild` chain (verify green + deliberate red, record output on the
  parent).
- Confirm `npm run build` still succeeds and the full suite is green at the
  dev-push gate; document the gate in the docs item.

## Key files

- `package.json` — NEW script + prebuild chain.

## Dependencies

- Edge to the static-check implementation item (runs its script).

# Docs and barrel docblock for the node-safe surface

**Goal:** Make the manifest the authoritative, discoverable statement of the
node-safe `@ui` surface — retire the "probe with `vite-node` when in doubt"
advice, add the check + "adding a module" procedure, and state at the barrel's
own definition site that it is intentionally Phaser-bearing. Parent:
CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/DEVELOPER.md` § *Phaser-free `@ui` helper imports for Node tests*
      gains the manifest as the authoritative list (link + the "adding a module
      to the surface" procedure), states the check and its `npm run
      check:ui-node-surface` script, and replaces "when in doubt, probe with a
      `vite-node` import" with "look it up in the manifest; if it is not listed,
      treat it as Phaser-bearing".
- [ ] `src/ui/index.ts` gains a short docblock above `UI_VERSION`: the barrel is
      **intentionally** Phaser-bearing (`CardGameScene extends Phaser.Scene`),
      Node tests must import deep Phaser-free paths, and it points at the
      manifest + check.
- [ ] `docs/ui-animations.md` node-safe note (under the `shakeIllegalMove`
      import block) points at the manifest + check.
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` is updated only where the hard-gate wiring / new npm script
      changes documented developer workflow (Doc-Update Policy) — the prebuild
      gate does change the build workflow, so it must be documented; if the
      change is judged non-workflow-affecting, record that decision here
      instead.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.


- [ ] `docs/DEVELOPER.md` documents the manifest as the authoritative node-safe
      list, the check + npm script, and the "adding a module to the surface"
      procedure, and retires the "probe with `vite-node` when in doubt" advice in
      favour of the lookup; `src/ui/index.ts` carries a docblock stating the
      barrel is intentionally Phaser-bearing and that Node tests must import
      deep Phaser-free paths; `docs/ui-animations.md` links the manifest.
      Code comments cross-link `CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN`.

## Minimal implementation

- Edit `docs/DEVELOPER.md`, `src/ui/index.ts`, `docs/ui-animations.md`, and
  (conditionally) `AGENTS.md` / `README.md` where the change is user-visible.
- Verify the docs read correctly and links resolve.

## Key files

- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — modified section.
- `src/ui/index.ts` — docblock above `UI_VERSION`.
- `docs/ui-animations.md` — node-safe note pointer.
- `AGENTS.md` — only if the workflow-doc gate applies.

## Dependencies

- Edge to the manifest item (documents it).
- Edge to the gate-wiring item (documents the script + gate).
